text:
ain_marketing: quick flag — inbound HubSpot leads are piling up in enrichment and assignments to Salesforce are delayed ~5-10m, SDR SLA impacted. :frowning:

noah_ops: yup seeing the same. spike around 11:45-12:00 PST. RR claim slots look saturated; claims succeed but SF create hangs. :eyes:

rachel_salesops: SLA targets are assign <2m, SF create <5m. current >5m rate ~13%. not great for SDR conversion.

jordan_engineer: pipeline: HS webhook -> enrichment async -> RR-claim -> SF-create. when enrichment retries accumulate RR holds items waiting for enriched payloads.

ain_marketing: can we do a short-term bypass?

jordan_engineer: propose fallback TTL: after 75s bypass enrichment and send minimal payload to SF with property `enrich_skipped=true` and tag `bypass_75s_peak`. also temporarily bump enrichment workers.

noah_ops: agree but gate to 30m canary during peak. ops will watch for noise.

rachel_salesops: please add a dashboard filter for `enrich_skipped` so SDRs can ignore or treat differently.

jordan_engineer: config i'll flip quickly: `enrichment.timeout_s=75; enrichment.fallback=true; fallback.tag=bypass_75s_peak; enrichment.workers=32`

deploybot: deploy started by noah_ops at 1749998905 :rocket:

jordan_engineer: deployed and enabled fallback. warming workers.

ain_marketing: early signal: >5m assigns down from 13% -> 3% in 4m. will notify SDR leads: "Temporary fallback active; records may show `enrich_skipped=true`."

rachel_salesops: great. next steps: jordan to file RFC for RR fairness + TTL degrade patterns; noah to add alert `enrichment.backlog > 500`; ain to own SDR comms.

noah_ops: alert created. will page if threshold persists.

ain_marketing: thanks all — sync in #marketing-ops tomorrow."
